newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal upgrades Teva.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal upgrades Teva.

text.p: -- Gruntal Investment Research said it upgraded Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd to long-term outperform from neutral, citing Thursday's U.S. Food and Drug Administration advisory panel recommendation in favor of Teva's multiple sclerosis drug Copaxone.
-- Gruntal analysts raised their 1997 earnings per share estimate to $2.70 from $2.25 and set a 1998 estimate at $4.00. They have a 1996 estimate of $1.25 a share.
-- They have a two-year price target of $80.
-- The stock was off 1-5/16 to 45-11/16 after gaining 3-1/2 on Thursday.
